We have conducted a diligent search for records responsive to your request. We have located responsive records, which we have released to you. The records can be viewed and downloaded by going to the Documents tab on your request. Due to the need to continue searching, reviewing and redacting records, we will produce any additional responsive records as soon as reasonably possible on an incremental or rolling basis. 

We have withheld records responsive to your request [and/or redacted parts of the records provided in response to your request] on the basis that the information contained may reveal vulnerabilities to, or otherwise increase the potential for an attack on, an information technology system of a public agency. (Cal. Govt. Code 7929.210)

Please note that some records may be responsive to more than one item in your request. In such cases, we have provided you with just one copy.

Due to privacy concerns, personal information, such as personal phone numbers, signatures, cell numbers and email addresses, has been redacted from the documents that we are making available to you. We redacted this personal information pursuant to Section 16.130 of the San Francisco Charter; Section 7927.700 and Section 7927.705 of the California Public Records Act; and Article 1, Section 1 of the California Constitution.

Regards,

David A. Steinberg

Custodian of Records

San Francisco Public Works

timeline.timeline_display_text:
We received your public records request, dated 10/2. You have requested records related to the following locations:

eastbound Page Street from Octavia Boulevard to Market Street, including all bike lanes, bikeways, and bicycle markings on that segment;

(b) the intersection of Market Street, Page Street, and Franklin Street, and the adjacent intersection of Market Street and 12th Street, including all traffic signals, bicycle signals, crosswalks, and markings within them;

(c) the route by which eastbound bicyclists travel from the Page Street bike lane into and along the eastbound Market Street bike lane, including any bike lane extension markings, green conflict markings, bike boxes, or turn boxes;

(d) eastbound Market Street from Gough Street through 12th Street, including the eastbound bike lane or bikeway (Class II or Class IV); and

(e) all raised medians, islands, and curbs within or adjacent to the routes described in (a) through (d). This includes the raised median in Market Street near the Page/Franklin and 12th Street intersections, the median's approach end ("nose"), and the flexible delineators, curb markings, object markers, pavement markings, and signs associated with it.

Our department will identify and compile the requested information. The Sunshine Ordinance requires departments to respond as soon as possible or within 10 calendar days from receipt of any records requests. Therefore, we will contact you as soon as the responsive documents are ready for you to view and will do so on or before 10/12, as permitted by San Francisco Administrative Code § 67.21(b) and California Government Code § 7922.535.

It is not necessary to create a NextRequest account to view responsive records. Once they have been released, a link, valid for 30 days, will be provided to view the records. Additionally, unless privacy concerns prevent it, Public Works makes all records requests visible to the public. You may search for requests at https://sanfrancisco.nextrequest.com/. 

Please note that we are only able to provide records in the possession or control of San Francisco Public Works. Other City agencies may hold additional responsive records and you would need to contact them directly.
